Class TcpRuntimeConnection

java.lang.Object
com.github.copilot.rpc.RuntimeConnection
com.github.copilot.rpc.TcpRuntimeConnection
@CopilotExperimental public final class TcpRuntimeConnection extends RuntimeConnection
Spawns a runtime child process listening on a TCP socket and connects to it. Construct with RuntimeConnection.forTcp().
Since:
1.0.0
